newsitem.title: USA: FSA lists secondary market insurance capacity.
newsitem.headline: FSA lists secondary market insurance capacity.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday it has remaining secondary market insurance capacity for the following issues:
--Pennsylvania Convention Center, refunding revenue bonds, 1994 series A, dated 6/1/1994.
--Philadelphia Municipal Authority, lease revenue refunding bonds, dated 11/1/1993.
--Contra Costa County, Calif., pension benefit obligation bonds.
--San Diego County, Calif., pension obligation bonds, series A.
--Sonoma County, Calif., pension obligation bonds, series 1993.
Capacity is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. For more information, call Tom Byrne at 212-826-0601.
